headline: VectorFL Paper is proving one maturation loop, not building a decorative agent dashboard.
why_this_exists: Give the human supervisor one immediate reading surface for direction, current proof state, and the single remaining gate.

what_we_are_doing: using scenario-bearing material as the real input
running internal read before broad external expansion
keeping external comparison thin and selective
writing results back into runtime trace and reopen loop
preparing the seam for later promotion into VectorFL Paper proper
what_we_are_not_doing: building a dark-theme task manager for its own sake
expanding into many cells or many programs before one loop is proven

already_proven: actual export swap seam is prepared
still_not_proven: final promotion into VectorFL Paper proper

single_remaining_gate.name: actual_export_only
single_remaining_gate.description: A real exported host record must replace the placeholder slot occupant and be rerun through packet v4.
single_remaining_gate.why_it_matters: This is the last realism gate before naming promotion into VectorFL Paper proper.

supervisor_takeaway: The work is not drifting into internal-only closure. The structure is moving in the intended direction, but the reading surface for the human supervisor still needs ongoing simplification.
